sections.description: Select the orientation model used to calculate the κ² distribution.

descriptions: Wobbling-in-cone orientations constrained by the measured donor and acceptor residual anisotropies.
Diffusion-with-traps orientation model including the supplied FRET efficiency.
Unrestricted isotropic donor and acceptor orientations, whose mean orientation factor is two thirds.
sections.description: Wobbling-in-Cone, Diffusion-with-Traps, or isotropic orientation model.

sections.title: Anisotropy Parameters
sections.description: Measured fundamental and residual anisotropies constrain donor and acceptor orientations.

sections.description: Fundamental anisotropy of the dye.

sections.description: Residual anisotropy of the donor without FRET.

sections.label: r_A∞
sections.description: Residual anisotropy of direct-excited acceptor.

sections.label: r_AD∞
sections.description: Residual anisotropy of FRET-sensitised acceptor.

sections.description: Set the assumed orientation factor and the numerical resolution of the distribution.

sections.description: Assumed orientation factor used for R_app / R_DA.

sections.label: Step (°)

sections.description: Number of bins in the κ² histogram.

sections.description: When checked, use the δ angle computed from residual anisotropies.
